title: Essay Passage: Learning
titleMy: စာစီစာကုံး - သင်ယူလေ့လာခြင်း
description: Type a longer essay passage about learning.

exercises.instruction: Learning is a lifelong journey that begins at birth and continues until the end of life. Every skill we master, from reading a book to typing a letter, opens a new door. The best learners stay curious and never fear mistakes, because mistakes are the footprints on the road to mastery.
